newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: United Engineers sees better profit.
newsitem.headline: United Engineers sees better profit.

text.p: Diversified United Engineers Ltd said on Tuesday it expected its profit to continue to improve.

It said it had Singapore $400 million in orders as of June 30. These included contracts for an incineration plant and two condominium projects in Singapore, medical equipment and supplies in Hong Kong, hospital support services in Taiwan, Malaysia and Singapore, among others.
United Engineers reported a 58 percent rise in net profit at S$7.37 million for first half ended June 30 1996.
